text:
Sam Carter: Heads-up — looks like two people signed up to chair the PIR for last week's outage (Thu 9/14). Can we sort who runs it? @Maria @Devon
incident-bot: Incident 2026-09-14-42 created a PIR: https://redwood.ops/incidents/2026-09-14-42 :spiral_calendar:
Maria Nguyen: Oh, I clicked the 'volunteer' button earlier but didn't expect anyone else to. I can step back if Devon already has the prep doc.
Devon Patel: I was assigned by calendar auto-assign this morning; I didn't realize Maria volunteered too. I can run it but I have a late customer call at 09:30 PT.
Sam Carter: Thanks — curious if calendar assignment should win vs manual volunteer. ops_oncall can you check the auto-assign logs?
ops_oncall: Checked the assigner logs — auto-assign picked Devon (rule: oncall -> available -> not shadowing). Maria's volunteer came later and wasn't reconciled. Looks like a race.
Maria Nguyen: Oh got it. I can take scribe if Devon chairs, no problem. Happy to split slides/pre-read. :+1:
Devon Patel: That works for me. If Maria will scribe, I can do the readout. I can move my customer call to 10:00 PT if that helps.
Linda R: Quick ask — can we set a rule for duplicates so this doesn't happen again? Maybe auto-assign should mark the thread or DM the volunteer if someone is already assigned.
Sam Carter: Agreed. For this PIR: Devon chairs, Maria scribe. Devon can switch the 09:30 call to 10:00 PT; Maria will own the pre-read + timeline. I'll add folks to the invite.
Sam Carter: Actions so far:
- Devon: chair + run slides (due Tue 09/12)
- Maria: scribe + pre-read (due Mon 09/11)
- Linda: create a short RFC for assigner behavior (due Fri 09/08)
- ops_oncall: add reconcile hook to auto-assign to DM volunteers when a calendar assignment exists (investigate by Wed 09/06)

Sam Carter: Proposed PIR times (pick one) — timezone: PT
```
- Tue 09/12 09:00-09:45
- Wed 09/13 08:00-08:45 (earlier for EU folks)
- Thu 09/14 09:00-09:45 (original slot)
```
Devon Patel: Tue 09/12 09:00 PT works best for me after I rebook the call.
Maria Nguyen: Wed 08:00 PT is okay for me if we need earlier, but Tue 09:00 PT is fine too.
ops_oncall: Noted — I will prototype a DM flow for the assigner and drop a link to a short design doc here by EOD today.
Sam Carter: Perfect. I'll update the invite to Tue 09/12 09:00 PT and add the agenda. Devon/Maria, ping me if that time doesn't actually work after you reshuffle.
Devon Patel: Thanks. Also adding a quick checklist for the PIR runbook: incident timeline, mitigation steps, root cause analysis draft, action owners list.
Maria Nguyen: I'll upload the timeline to the doc by Mon morning.
Linda R: Filing the RFC draft — will link in this thread when ready.
Sam Carter: Closing loop: Chair = Devon, Scribe = Maria, Ops follow-up = ops_oncall/Linda. If no blockers by Mon 09/11 12:00 PT I will lock the invite. :lock:
ops_oncall: FYI I put a quick note in the assigner repo about a possible race condition and a unit test to catch duplicate volunteer/assign cases.
Devon Patel: Thanks everyone. See you Tue. :raised_hands:
Maria Nguyen: Thanks!
incident-bot: Reminder set for PIR 1761112222 on 1762010000 (Tue 09/12 09:00 PT).
